schema.source_repo: GitHub owner/repo the file was copied from, e.g. dust2ash7/raven-flock-assets
schema.source_commit: full 40-char commit sha of source_repo the file was copied at
schema.path: path of the file inside source_repo
schema.dest: path under public/ in this repo; served at /<dest> (e.g. models/keeper.glb)
schema.sha256: hex sha256 of the copied file
